title: Passing an uninitialized variable to a preg_match() out-parameter is idiomatic PHP

ground_truth.statement: Passing an uninitialized local variable $matches as the by-reference out-parameter of preg_match() produces no runtime warning or notice under E_ALL and populates $matches on match.

notes: PHPStan 2.3.1 and Psalm 6.20.1 accept uninitialized variables passed to @param-out parameters without diagnostics. Mago 1.60.2 recognizes @param-out for $matches[1] downstream, yet still emits help-level reference-to-undefined-variable on $matches in the preg_match() call.
